keyEvents.text: Own Goal by Nikola Milenkovic, Nottingham Forest. Brentford 1, Nottingham Forest 0.
Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham Forest) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Nottingham Forest. Daniel Muñoz replaces Ola Aina.
Substitution, Nottingham Forest. Ryan Yates replaces Xaver Schlager.
Delay in match because of an injury Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Brentford. Mikkel Damsgaard replaces Mathias Jensen.
Substitution, Brentford. Aaron Hickey replaces Mamadou Sangaré.
Daniel Muñoz (Nottingham Forest) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Nottingham Forest. Chris Wood replaces Liam Delap.
Substitution, Nottingham Forest. Arnaud Kalimuendo replaces Dan Ndoye.
Michael Kayode (Brentford) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Brentford. Jaidon Anthony replaces Dango Ouattara.
Goal! Brentford 2, Nottingham Forest 0. Igor Thiago (Brentford) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Jaidon Anthony following a fast break.
James McAtee (Nottingham Forest) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Brentford. Callum Wilson replaces Kevin Schade.
